messages:
Ava (product): Quick check — for the Edge Prefetch pilot we need a dependency matrix + sequencing across runtime/infra/sec/platform. Proposed timeline: staging feature-flag by 2026-05-10, canary 2026-05-17, GA 2026-06-01. Can owners confirm blockers and rough estimates? cc @Sam @Jordan @Priya @Diego
Sam - EngRuntime: +1. Runtime work: make KV cache eviction cache-safe for prefetch + batching tweaks for short tail latency. Rough estimate: 2 weeks dev + 3 days perf/validation. Need infra staging GPU quota and a test model variant. @Jordan can you confirm quota?
Jordan - Infra: Staging GPU quota available but we need to open egress to the prefetch collector and update the LB config for ephemeral endpoints. I estimate ~5 business days to do infra changes + smoke testing. Can run in parallel with runtime unit tests. Will file infra RFC/PR today.
Priya (security): Egress change requires a quick threat model + egress ACL review. If you send the design doc + CIDR list I can turn around a review in ~3 business days. Also flagging KMS usage for cached credentials — we'll need to confirm no secret material is stored in the cache.
Diego - EngPlatform: Platform tasks: feature-flag rollout config, canary routing rules, and observability hooks (token-level latency + per-route cost). Plan ~4 days. I can own the canary automation but need the routing policy from runtime. Also request a low-traffic commit window for canary.
Ava (product): Thanks — minimal design below (will paste into GH after this thread):
```
Edge Prefetch - minimal dep matrix
- Runtime: KV eviction, batching, fallback routing (owner: Sam)
- Infra: egress ACLs, LB config, staging GPU quota (owner: Jordan)
- Security: threat model + KMS check (owner: Priya)
- Platform: feature flags + canary automation (owner: Diego)
Milestones:
1) Design doc + CIDR list -> security review (3d)
2) Runtime infra changes in staging -> perf tests (2w + 3d)
3) Canary automation + rollout (4d)
4) GA after canary (1wk observation)
```
Sam - EngRuntime: One more runtime note — need a routing fallback for the quantized edge variant. If the edge host can't serve the quantized model, route to a compatible fallback in eu-region. Routing policy change is small (~1 day) but important for graceful degradation.
Jordan - Infra: Confirm we can reserve 10.0.2.0/24 for prefetch collector and will open the PR for LB + egress. I'll add notes about CIDRs in the PR so Priya has what she needs.
Priya (security): Link the design doc here when ready. I'll prioritize review today once I have the CIDRs and the cache dataflow diagram: https://redwood.internal/docs/edge-prefetch-design
Ava (product): Great. Let's do a 15-min sync at 11:30 PT today to lock blockers and owners. If anyone can't make it, drop availability and we'll swap. :calendar:
Diego - EngPlatform: Works for me. @Sam can you bring a perf test plan + a quick synthetic run for staging?
Sam - EngRuntime: Yep — I'll bring the perf plan and a short synthetic run (p95/p99) and post initial numbers in the doc before the sync.
Ava (product): Awesome — thanks all. I'll post the GH draft and invite the reviewers after the sync. :thumbsup:
